question: Using the full pre-task conversation, identify the historical requirements and message evidence that are relevant to the current client task. Exclude unrelated history and do not treat the current task itself as historical evidence.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: Creativity should be rendered as one word.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: What turnaround time should I expect?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thanks for contacting me. Please send the images first; after I review them, I can give you the exact turnaround.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: This is something I can do easily.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Will the process include opportunities for feedback and revisions?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: You’ll receive it tomorrow at the same time.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes ofcourse

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: One quick clarification: does the 85$ price apply to each illustration?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: No, the budget covers all 8.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: If it doesn’t work out, that’s okay.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Given how detailed these vector art drawings are, $85 honestly feels quite low. Could we set the total at $140?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: If it’s possible for you, could you consider this request?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Along with the final source files, I’ll provide completely hand-drawn vector illustrations.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thank you—I understand, and I wouldn’t want your labor to be underpaid.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: No worries—we can proceed with $85.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thanks! Please send me the contract offer.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The benefit to my profile health is why I want this project.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Underpaying you for this project is not something I want to do.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: No need to worry; I agree to complete the work within this budget.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For this design, please use this type of bottle. Above it, place “Creativity grows around the Campfire” as cloud-shaped text like in the samples.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Everything else in this design looks good. Please use this referenced cartoon style to make it more cartoon-ish, and make “Creativity grows around the Campfire” on the meat appear stamped, like it does on the burger. Does that make sense?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Although the rest of the design looks good, it needs to feel more cartoon-ish. The grill contents are wrong—please use steak and onions. Keep “Creativity grows around the Campfire” looking like smoke, but make it a little easier to read.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I appreciate you taking this project on. One last note: I’d also be happy to add a bonus for your work.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Thanks for offering me the contract, Nolan. I’m starting work now and will update you soon. I’d really appreciate the bonus as well. 😊

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Absolutely, the bonus is approved!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: If any project questions come up, please let me know.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Everything is clear for now, so I’m starting the work. I’ll share illustration one with you soon.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For the final file, should I provide AI (Adobe Illustrator) or PSD (Photoshop)?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: PNG and JPG.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I’ve finished it and sent it over; please take a look. Thanks!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Although the work is off to a good start, I do have some feedback.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please give this design the more cartoon-ish look shown in my included example.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please add a text bubble to this design and make the font/text large enough to span the whole sky. Lastly, remove “Meadowbrook” and replace it with “Riverton.” Thanks!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The design is otherwise great. Please make the text easier to read and reshape the steaks so they resemble the included sample.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I’ll make those changes and return the revised work soon.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thank you!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The changes are now complete—please take a look. :)

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please use the font at <https://www.dafont.com/cloud-sketch.font?text=storytelling> for this design, and arrange the text across two straight lines.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The displayed slogan should read: “Creativity grows around the campfire”.
